description:
The 007 3rd - 1st Guided Mountain Bike Ride on the 007 trail network is a hidden gem and the most popular in Bass Lake, California. Your guide will lead you on a ride that will take you up Central Camp Road (dirt road) to the top of the 007 3rd single-track trail. We will connect with the Octopussy trail, an alternative to riding the entire 3rd section of 007. Octopussy is rated a black diamond trail that begins with a wide-open, fast descent. The trail will then become more challenging, with tight turns leading to a rock garden filled with large boulders and rock ledges. There are multiple lines to choose from, with some being more challenging than others. Your guide will help you navigate the best route for you. After this section, the trail becomes fast and flowy with some high-speed sections and jumps, natural berms, and rocky sections that quickly sneak up on you as you descend to Central Camp Road and 007 2nd entrance.

Tours are contingent based on your skill level, may be adjusted based on skill level.
what_is_included:
- **Your Pedal Forward Guide:** Our local guide knows the trails intimately and are there to ensure a fun and safe riding experience. Additionally, they can assist with mechanical support and suggestions on where to ride next. They will also educate you on the area’s flora, fauna, and history.
- 3% mandatory National Forest Service fee that passes through directly to the US Forest Service
- Our commitment to excellence!
